summary: This interactive Roblox mission trainer immerses players ages seven through twelve in an Artemis-inspired lunar base construction experience. Working in teams or with out, junior astronauts retrieve supply modules from rovers, transport them across the Moon, and execute realistic engineering assembly steps while learning authentic NASA scientific facts throughout every mission stage.
details: an interactive mission trainer on Roblox where players ages 7–12 step into the boots of a junior astronaut and complete a real lunar base construction mission on the Moon. Inspired by NASA's Artemis program, players retrieve supply modules from a rover, carry them to a build site, install them using real engineering steps, and learn genuine NASA science facts at every stage — all within a timed, team-based mission.
